public_rationale: Capacity-driven restrictions and criticism from a previously successful user are documented. Those facts support parts of the sentence. They do not establish that the industry was sold on a lie or that capacity problems caused the wider backlash.
limitations: The claim combines an identifiable service problem with a broad allegation of deception.
The customer analysis is firsthand evidence of dissatisfaction, not a representative survey or controlled causal study.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The AI industry was sold on a lie, and capacity problems are turning even true believers against the AI labs.

statement.excerpt: This entire industry has been sold on a lie, and as capacity becomes an issue, even true believers are turning on the AI labs.
statement.document_title: I Will Never Respect A Website

from_speaker: even true believers are turning on the AI labs
our_interpretation: Read in context, the alleged lie concerns selling AI services on expectations of quality and access that the labs could not sustain.
Turning on the labs means public criticism by previously enthusiastic users; it does not require abandoning AI.
The recent backlash is assessed over March 1–April 14, 2026, the latest completed month and current month before publication. Earlier sales commitments would be contextual evidence.
Capacity problems and complaints occurring together do not by themselves establish deception or causation.
criteria.support_condition: Identify materially misleading sales commitments, evidence that they could not be sustained, and documented reversals by prior enthusiasts linked to capacity-driven restrictions. Evidence must justify the claimed industry-wide scope.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes that the identified commitments were accurately qualified and fulfilled, or that the alleged reversals did not occur or arose from unrelated causes.
